anyOf.const: Optional limits configuration could not be read within the supported format and size limit.

anyOf.const: Accounting may be incomplete: matching numeric token states across evidence files were excluded without a proven process/request identity. Distinct requests can have identical counters.

A higher cumulative receipt lower bound was retained instead of message prices. Tokens and request counts retain message evidence; provider-reported value and model cost allocations can cover a different retained interval and have no request dates.
